lines.beaver: 민호야! 나 다음 달에 결혼하는 거 알지?
lines.beaver_en: Minho! You know I'm getting married next month, right?
lines.beaver_roman: Minhoya! Na daeum dare gyeolhonhaneun geo alji?
lines.en: Of course! Did you already pick a wedding hall?

lines.beaver: 응, 강남에 있는 작은 예식장으로 정했어.
lines.beaver_en: Yeah, I chose a small wedding hall in Gangnam.
lines.beaver_roman: Eung, gangname inneun jageun yesikjangeuro jeonghaesseo.
lines.en: That's great! How did you get proposed to?

lines.beaver_en: My boyfriend gave me a ring by the Han River.
lines.en: Wow, it's like a movie! Did you kiss too?

lines.beaver: 하하, 비밀이야. 너는 요즘 만나는 사람 있어?
lines.beaver_en: Haha, that's a secret. Are you seeing anyone these days?
lines.beaver_roman: Haha, bimiriya. Neoneun yojeum mannaneun saram isseo?
lines.learner: 아니, 요즘은 이성 친구도 별로 없어.
lines.en: No, I don't even have many friends of the opposite sex lately.
lines.roman: Ani, yojeumeun iseong chingudo byeollo eopseo.

lines.beaver_en: You had someone you dated for a long time, remember?
lines.learner: 아, 대학 때 사귀던 사람? 벌써 3년 전이야.
lines.en: Oh, the one I used to date in college? That was 3 years ago.
lines.roman: A, daehak ttae sagwideon saram? Beolsseo samnyeon jeoniya.

lines.beaver_en: You two were such a lovely couple back then.
lines.learner: 그랬지. 근데 그 사람은 너무 바빴잖아.
lines.en: We were. But he was way too busy, you know.
lines.roman: Geuraetji. Geunde geu sarameun neomu bappatjana.

lines.beaver_en: I see. Are you thinking of dating again?
lines.learner: 응, 올해는 좋은 사람을 만날 생각이야.
lines.en: Yes, I'm thinking of meeting someone nice this year.
lines.roman: Eung, olhaeneun joeun sarameul mannal saenggagiya.

lines.beaver: 좋다! 우리 신랑 친구 소개해 줄까?
lines.beaver_en: Great! Should I introduce you to my groom's friend?
lines.beaver_roman: Jota! Uri sillang chingu sogaehae julkka?
lines.en: Really? Thanks. Where's your newlywed home?

lines.beaver: 회사 근처야. 저녁때 같이 요리할 거야.
lines.beaver_en: Near work. We'll cook together in the evenings.
lines.beaver_roman: Hoesa geuncheoya. Jeonyeokttae gachi yorihal geoya.
lines.learner: 와, 신혼부부 같다! 벌써 여보라고 불러?
lines.en: Wow, you're like newlyweds! Do you already call each other honey?
lines.roman: Wa, sinhonbubu gatda! Beolsseo yeoborago bulleo?

lines.beaver: 하하, 가끔. 청첩장 보내 줄게. 꼭 와!
lines.beaver_en: Haha, sometimes. I'll send you an invitation. Be sure to come!
lines.beaver_roman: Haha, gakkeum. Cheongcheopjang bonae julge. Kkok wa!
lines.en: Of course! I'll come wearing a purple tie.
